name: Ah! Youth!
description: A headpiece modeled after the wispae "Golden Youth." People's regrets over unfinished business from their youth have coalesced into this little guy.
story:
Ten years later, you can't bring yourself to open that tiny gift box you'd long forgotten. You worry there might be an unopened letter inside, but you're equally afraid it's just a gift.

"I still remember running beneath the sunset that day... that was the youth I lost!"

source.description: Trailblaze Fashion obtained from the "Cosmicon, Roll On!" event
